title: Running Your Tests
description: Five pytest commands, each with a different scope: the whole suite, one class, tests whose name matches a keyword, and stopping at the first failure.

steps.description: These commands run the test suite, each with a different scope. The page introduces them under Running Your Tests. Every line carries a comment that names what it does.
`pytest tests/ -v` runs every test under `tests/`. The `-v` flag is verbose output, which names each test as it runs.
`pytest tests/test_mylang.py::TestFunctions -v` runs only one class, `TestFunctions`, from the file `tests/test_mylang.py`.
`pytest tests/ -k "closure" -v` runs only the tests whose name contains `closure`.
`pytest tests/ -x` stops at the first failure.
